PM Modi Embarks on Multi-Nation Indo-Pacific Visit

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has begun a multi-nation visit focusing on the Indo-Pacific region, aiming to strengthen strategic partnerships. The tour includes stops in Indonesia and Japan, with discussions centered on defense cooperation, critical minerals, and broader strategic ties. The visits are expected to deepen existing relationships and explore new avenues for collaboration.
